headline: Mexican peso recovers ground against the dollar after breaking the 19-unit barrier
summary: The peso gained after a sharp depreciation session, as the dollar retreated. It had broken the 19-per-dollar level for the first time since June 2025 the previous day.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency, and its moves affect import costs, inflation expectations and the returns of dollar-based investors holding Mexican assets.
why_moved: The peso rebounded as the US dollar retreated, following a session of sharp depreciation that had pushed it past 19 per dollar.
original_headline: Peso mexicano recupera terreno frente al dólar tras romper la barrera de 19 unidades
